markets.title: Nick Martinez: 3+ strikeouts?
markets.rules_primary: If Nick Martinez records 3+ strikeouts in the Tampa Bay vs Cleveland professional baseball game originally scheduled for Oct 18, 2026 at 5:00 PM EDT, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Player Participation & Settlement Criteria
If Nick Martinez is scratched or is not a starting pitcher, the market will resolve to the fair market price.
If Nick Martinez is not a starting pitcher but later enters the game, the market will resolve to the fair market price, relief appearances will not count towards this market.
If Nick Martinez is a starting pitcher and records at least one batter faced the market will settle based on strikeouts recorded.
